skill_name: Summarize the problem with plastic in oceans.
workflow: The issue of plastic pollution in oceans is one of the biggest environmental concerns today. Over 8 million tons of plastic is dumped into the world’s oceans each year, contaminating the aquatic ecosystem and damaging it in many ways. The plastic often breaks down into smaller pieces and is ingested by fish, seabirds and other wildlife, causing digestive tract blockages that can lead to starvation.
